prompt.zh-CN: 3×3 矩阵 A 的一行乘以 5 得到 B。若 det(A)=-2，则 det(B) 等于多少？
prompt.en-US: A 3x3 matrix B is obtained from A by multiplying one row by 5. If det(A)=-2, what is det(B)?

reveal.zh-CN: 行列式对任意一行都是线性的，一行乘以 5，整个行列式也乘以 5。
reveal.en-US: The determinant is linear in each row, so scaling one row by 5 scales the whole determinant by 5.

prompt.en-US: What are the eigenvalues of the matrix [[2,1],[0,3]]?

reveal.zh-CN: 这是上三角矩阵，特征值就是主对角线元素 2 和 3。
reveal.en-US: It is upper triangular, so the eigenvalues are the diagonal entries 2 and 3.

prompt.zh-CN: 关于 n×n 矩阵可对角化，下列哪些说法一定正确？
prompt.en-US: Which statements about diagonalizability of an n x n matrix are always true?

text.zh-CN: 若有 n 个线性无关的特征向量，则可对角化
text.en-US: If it has n linearly independent eigenvectors, it is diagonalizable

text.zh-CN: 若有 n 个互不相同的特征值，则可对角化
text.en-US: If it has n distinct eigenvalues, it is diagonalizable

text.zh-CN: 只要行列式非零就一定可对角化
text.en-US: A nonzero determinant always guarantees diagonalizability

reveal.zh-CN: 可对角化的核心是有一组特征向量基；不同特征值会给出线性无关的特征向量。
reveal.en-US: Diagonalizability requires an eigenvector basis; distinct eigenvalues give linearly independent eigenvectors.

prompt.zh-CN: 若 P 是到某个子空间的正交投影矩阵，则 P 必然满足哪条关系？
prompt.en-US: If P is an orthogonal projection matrix onto a subspace, which relation must it satisfy?

reveal.zh-CN: 投影一次后已经落在子空间里，再投影不会改变结果，因此 P²=P。
reveal.en-US: After one projection the vector is already in the subspace, so projecting again changes nothing: P^2=P.

prompt.zh-CN: 求极限 lim_{x→0} (sin x)/x。
prompt.en-US: Evaluate the limit lim_{x->0} (sin x)/x.

reveal.zh-CN: 该极限等于 1，是微积分和小角近似里的常用基石。
reveal.en-US: The limit is 1, a standard cornerstone of calculus and small-angle approximations.

title.en-US: Peeking at the Second Taylor Term

prompt.zh-CN: 当 x 接近 0 时，e^x 的二阶泰勒近似是哪一个？
prompt.en-US: Near x=0, which is the second-order Taylor approximation of e^x?

reveal.zh-CN: e^x 的 Maclaurin 展开为 1+x+x²/2!+x³/3!+...。
reveal.en-US: The Maclaurin expansion of e^x is 1+x+x^2/2!+x^3/3!+... .

prompt.zh-CN: 函数 f(x,y)=x²+3y² 在点 (1,2) 的梯度是什么？
prompt.en-US: What is the gradient of f(x,y)=x^2+3y^2 at (1,2)?

reveal.en-US: The gradient is (2x,6y), which becomes (2,12) at (1,2).

prompt.zh-CN: 在约束 g(x,y)=0 下寻找 f(x,y) 的光滑极值时，常用的必要条件是哪一个？
prompt.en-US: For a smooth extremum of f(x,y) subject to g(x,y)=0, which necessary condition is commonly used?

text.en-US: f must be identical to g

reveal.zh-CN: 约束极值处若正则条件成立，目标函数梯度与约束梯度平行。
reveal.en-US: Under regularity conditions, the objective gradient is parallel to the constraint gradient at a constrained extremum.

title.en-US: The Square Root Behind a Gaussian Integral

prompt.zh-CN: 积分 ∫_{-∞}^{∞} e^{-x²} dx 约等于多少？保留 5 位小数。
prompt.en-US: What is the approximate value of the integral of e^{-x^2} from -infinity to infinity? Give 5 decimal places.

reveal.zh-CN: 经典高斯积分等于 √π≈1.77245，平方后转成极坐标积分是常见证明。
reveal.en-US: The classic Gaussian integral equals sqrt(pi), approximately 1.77245; squaring it and using polar coordinates is a standard proof.

prompt.zh-CN: 计算 ∫_0^1 2x cos(x²) dx，结果为？
prompt.en-US: Compute the integral from 0 to 1 of 2x cos(x^2) dx.

reveal.zh-CN: 令 u=x²，则 du=2x dx，积分变为 ∫_0^1 cos u du=sin 1。
reveal.en-US: Let u=x^2, so du=2x dx. The integral becomes integral_0^1 cos u du = sin 1.

prompt.zh-CN: 疾病先验概率 1%，检测灵敏度 99%，假阳性率 5%。某人检测阳性，其患病概率最接近多少？
prompt.en-US: A disease has prevalence 1%, test sensitivity 99%, and false positive rate 5%. If someone tests positive, what is the approximate probability they have the disease?

reveal.en-US: P is about 0.01*0.99/(0.01*0.99+0.99*0.05)=0.167. A low prior strongly lowers the posterior.

prompt.zh-CN: 若 X~Binomial(n=20,p=0.3)，E[X] 等于多少？
prompt.en-US: If X~Binomial(n=20,p=0.3), what is E[X]?

reveal.zh-CN: 二项分布期望为 np=20×0.3=6。
reveal.en-US: The expectation of a binomial distribution is np=20*0.3=6.

prompt.zh-CN: 若 X 服从参数为 λ 的泊松分布，则 Var(X) 等于什么？
prompt.en-US: If X follows a Poisson distribution with parameter lambda, what is Var(X)?

reveal.zh-CN: 泊松分布有一个很省心的性质：均值和方差都等于 λ。
reveal.en-US: A convenient property of the Poisson distribution is that both its mean and variance equal lambda.

title.en-US: The Star of the Central Limit Theorem

prompt.zh-CN: 在通常条件下，大量独立同分布随机变量的标准化样本均值趋向什么分布？
prompt.en-US: Under usual conditions, the standardized sample mean of many i.i.d. variables tends toward which distribution?

reveal.zh-CN: 中心极限定理解释了为什么正态曲线在统计里频繁出现。
reveal.en-US: The central limit theorem explains why normal curves appear so often in statistics.

prompt.zh-CN: 若行随机矩阵 P 的稳态分布为 π，则 π 应满足什么关系？
prompt.en-US: If pi is a stationary distribution for a row-stochastic matrix P, which relation should it satisfy?

text.zh-CN: π 的所有分量必须相等
text.en-US: All components of pi must be equal

reveal.zh-CN: 稳态分布经过一步转移后保持不变；行向量写法就是 πP=π。
reveal.en-US: A stationary distribution is unchanged after one transition; with row-vector notation, that is pi P = pi.

prompt.zh-CN: 一个连通无向图存在欧拉路但不存在欧拉回路时，奇度顶点个数应为多少？
prompt.en-US: In a connected undirected graph with an Euler trail but no Euler circuit, how many vertices have odd degree?

reveal.zh-CN: 欧拉回路要求 0 个奇度顶点；只有欧拉路而非回路时恰有 2 个奇度顶点。
reveal.en-US: An Euler circuit requires 0 odd-degree vertices; a non-circuit Euler trail requires exactly 2.

prompt.zh-CN: 完全图 K_8 有多少条边？
prompt.en-US: How many edges does the complete graph K_8 have?

reveal.zh-CN: K_n 的边数为 n(n-1)/2，所以 K_8 有 8×7/2=28 条边。
reveal.en-US: K_n has n(n-1)/2 edges, so K_8 has 8*7/2=28 edges.

prompt.zh-CN: 把 13 个物品放进 4 个盒子，至少有一个盒子里不少于多少个物品？
prompt.en-US: If 13 objects are placed into 4 boxes, at least one box contains at least how many objects?

reveal.zh-CN: 向上取整 13/4 得到 4；这是鸽巢原理的标准用法。
reveal.en-US: Ceiling(13/4)=4, the standard pigeonhole principle move.

prompt.zh-CN: 计算 7^4 mod 10 的结果。
prompt.en-US: Compute 7^4 mod 10.

reveal.en-US: 7^2=49 is congruent to 9 mod 10, so 7^4 is congruent to 9^2=81, hence 1 mod 10.

prompt.zh-CN: 递推 a_n=3a_{n-1}-2a_{n-2} 的特征方程根是什么？
prompt.en-US: What are the characteristic roots of the recurrence a_n=3a_{n-1}-2a_{n-2}?

reveal.zh-CN: 特征方程 r²-3r+2=0，分解为 (r-1)(r-2)=0。
reveal.en-US: The characteristic equation is r^2-3r+2=0, factoring as (r-1)(r-2)=0.

prompt.zh-CN: 复数 z=3-4i 的模 |z| 是多少？
prompt.en-US: What is the modulus |z| of z=3-4i?

prompt.zh-CN: 若 f(z)=u(x,y)+iv(x,y) 在区域内全纯，且偏导连续，则 u、v 满足哪组方程？
prompt.en-US: If f(z)=u(x,y)+iv(x,y) is holomorphic in a region with continuous partial derivatives, which equations do u and v satisfy?

reveal.zh-CN: 这是柯西-黎曼方程，是复函数可微性的核心条件之一。
reveal.en-US: These are the Cauchy-Riemann equations, a core condition for complex differentiability.

prompt.zh-CN: 函数 f(t)=1 的拉普拉斯变换是什么？假设 s>0。
prompt.en-US: What is the Laplace transform of f(t)=1, assuming s>0?

reveal.zh-CN: ∫_0^∞ e^{-st} dt=1/s，这是拉普拉斯表里的第一行常客。
reveal.en-US: The integral from 0 to infinity of e^{-st} dt is 1/s, a first-line entry in Laplace tables.

prompt.zh-CN: 微分方程 y'=2y 且 y(0)=3 的解是什么？
prompt.en-US: What is the solution to y'=2y with y(0)=3?

reveal.zh-CN: 方程 y'=ky 的解是 Ce^{kx}，代入 y(0)=3 得 C=3。
reveal.en-US: The equation y'=ky has solution Ce^{kx}; y(0)=3 gives C=3.

prompt.zh-CN: 从极坐标 (r,θ) 到直角坐标 (x,y) 的变量替换中，面积元 dxdy 等于什么？
prompt.en-US: In the change from polar coordinates (r,theta) to Cartesian coordinates (x,y), what is dxdy?

reveal.zh-CN: 极坐标的 Jacobian 绝对值为 r，所以面积元多出一个 r。
reveal.en-US: The absolute value of the polar-coordinate Jacobian is r, so the area element gains a factor r.

prompt.zh-CN: 线性映射 T: R^5 -> R^3 的秩为 2，则其零化度是多少？
prompt.en-US: A linear map T: R^5 -> R^3 has rank 2. What is its nullity?

reveal.zh-CN: 秩-零化度定理给出 rank + nullity = 定义域维数 = 5，因此零化度为 3。
reveal.en-US: Rank-nullity says rank + nullity equals the domain dimension 5, so the nullity is 3.

prompt.zh-CN: 若 Q 是实正交矩阵，则 Q^{-1} 等于什么？
prompt.en-US: If Q is a real orthogonal matrix, what is Q^{-1}?

reveal.zh-CN: 正交矩阵定义为 Q^T Q=I，因此它的逆矩阵就是转置矩阵。
reveal.en-US: An orthogonal matrix satisfies Q^T Q=I, so its inverse is its transpose.

prompt.zh-CN: 实对称矩阵一定具有什么性质？
prompt.en-US: Which property must a real symmetric matrix have?

reveal.zh-CN: 谱定理说明实对称矩阵有实特征值，并且可由正交矩阵对角化。
reveal.en-US: The spectral theorem says real symmetric matrices have real eigenvalues and are orthogonally diagonalizable.

prompt.zh-CN: 半径为 3 的球体体积约为多少？取 pi≈3.14159，保留 3 位小数。
prompt.en-US: What is the approximate volume of a sphere with radius 3? Use pi≈3.14159 and give 3 decimal places.

reveal.en-US: The volume is 4*pi*r^3/3; with r=3 and pi≈3.14159, it is 113.097.

prompt.zh-CN: 对于可相乘的方阵 A、B，迹 tr(AB) 与什么相等？
prompt.en-US: For square matrices A and B of compatible size, what is tr(AB) equal to?

reveal.zh-CN: 迹具有循环性质：tr(AB)=tr(BA)。更长乘积也可循环移动，但不能任意重排。
reveal.en-US: Trace is cyclic: tr(AB)=tr(BA). Longer products can be cyclically shifted, but not arbitrarily reordered.

prompt.zh-CN: 函数 f(x)=1/x 在区间 (0,1) 上是否一致连续？
prompt.en-US: Is f(x)=1/x uniformly continuous on the interval (0,1)?

text.zh-CN: 否，因为靠近 0 时变化可无限剧烈
text.en-US: No, because it can vary arbitrarily fast near 0
Yes, because it is continuous everywhere on the interval
Yes, because the interval is bounded above

text.zh-CN: 无法判断，因为没有导数
text.en-US: Cannot tell because it has no derivative

reveal.zh-CN: 在非闭区间靠近 0 时函数无界，连续不自动推出一致连续。
reveal.en-US: Near 0 on the non-closed interval, the function is unbounded; continuity alone does not imply uniform continuity.

prompt.zh-CN: 拓扑意义下，函数 f:X->Y 连续等价于哪项？
prompt.en-US: In topology, continuity of f:X->Y is equivalent to which statement?

text.zh-CN: Y 中每个开集的反向像在 X 中开
text.en-US: The preimage of every open set in Y is open in X

text.zh-CN: X 中每个开集的像在 Y 中开
text.en-US: The image of every open set in X is open in Y

reveal.zh-CN: 连续性用开集反向像刻画；开集的像不一定开。
reveal.en-US: Continuity is characterized by preimages of open sets; images of open sets need not be open.

title.zh-CN: 群的单位元只能有几个
title.en-US: How Many Identities Can a Group Have

prompt.zh-CN: 一个群中单位元的个数是多少？
prompt.en-US: How many identity elements can a group have?

text.en-US: The same as the order of the group

text.zh-CN: 如果群无限则没有单位元
text.en-US: If the group is infinite, it has none

reveal.zh-CN: 若 e 和 e' 都是单位元，则 e=ee'=e'，所以单位元唯一。
reveal.en-US: If e and e' are both identities, then e=ee'=e', so the identity is unique.

title.en-US: Constant Term of a Characteristic Polynomial

prompt.zh-CN: 对 n×n 矩阵 A，特征多项式 p(λ)=det(λI-A) 的常数项是什么？
prompt.en-US: For an n x n matrix A, what is the constant term of p(lambda)=det(lambda I-A)?

reveal.zh-CN: 令 λ=0 得 p(0)=det(-A)=(-1)^n det(A)。
reveal.en-US: Set lambda=0: p(0)=det(-A)=(-1)^n det(A).
